verdict.rationale: Sardine is an API-driven fraud and compliance platform, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question for it. The pack only says API references are protected (sardine-docs-3) and mentions APIs such as /businesses, with nothing on API versioning or a deprecation policy. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
